subject: Least-Privilege attestation runbook + SCIM log delivery for SIG onboarding
messages:
From: Taylor Brooks <taylor.brooks@medtechco.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: security@medtechco.com
Date: Mon, 27 Dec 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: SIG intake — SCIM deltas + least-privilege attestation

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call this morning. As discussed, our SIG team still needs a few items to complete the access control section:

- SCIM delta export covering the last 90 days (user add/removal/attribute changes).
- Sample SAML assertions for admin-role sign-ons (redacted as needed).
- A least-privilege attestation for service accounts and privileged roles (current owners + last attestation date).

Our target is to close this portion of the questionnaire by Jan 7; would you be able to provide the artifacts or a delivery plan by Jan 5? If you can provide a secure link or an SFTP endpoint, that works for us.

Also, please highlight any gaps or items that will require a longer runbook so we can note them in the SIG response.

Appreciate it — Taylor
Taylor Brooks
Security Operations, MedTechCo
phone: +1 (415) 555-0182
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Brooks <taylor.brooks@medtechco.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake — SCIM deltas + least-privilege attestation

Hi Taylor — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver a scoped package and a short runbook for how we generated each artifact. High-level plan:

1) SCIM delta export (90 days): Jordan will produce a ZIP containing the delta CSVs and a manifest. We will provide a sampling of user attribute changes mapped to role assignments.
2) SAML assertions: we will export 10 anonymized admin-session assertions (timestamps and roles preserved; names redacted).
3) Least-privilege attestation: we will produce an owner/role matrix (service accounts + human roles) that shows current owners and last attestation date.

Questions for scope:
- Do you want service accounts that are machine-to-machine only (no human owner) included in the attestation list, or do you prefer those to be listed separately?
- For SCIM deltas, would you prefer a single consolidated CSV or a directory of per-day files?

We can target a first drop by Tue Jan 4 and a final bundle by Thu Jan 7, pending your answer on scope above. I attached a short runbook template for SIG deliveries (runbook stub).

Cheers,

--
Soojin Lee
Senior Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
Attachments: runbook-stub.md (text)

Subject: Re: SIG intake — SCIM deltas + least-privilege attestation

Taylor — looping in the extraction details.

Planned deliverables (first drop):
- scim-delta-202612.zip (contains deltas_20261001-20261227.csv, manifest.json, checksum.txt)
- saml-assertions-samples.txt (10 redacted assertion blobs)
- leastpriv-matrix.xlsx (owner, role, last_attested, notes)

Delivery method: We will upload the ZIP to a secure S3 bucket with a pre-signed link and also provide an SFTP option if you prefer. The manifest will include hashes and a mapping of delta rows to role changes. We will scrub PII from SAML assertions by replacing name/email attributes with hashed tokens; other attributes (role, assertion-time) will remain intact.

Scope clarifications:
- Service accounts (machine accounts) will be in the matrix but flagged in a separate column — let us know if you want those omitted entirely.
- SCIM repro cadence: consolidated CSV by default; can also provide daily files if you need them for timestamped reconciliation.

Attachments: scim-delta-202612.zip (will be uploaded, stub attached here), leastpriv-matrix.xlsx (current draft).

Perfect — that plan works for us. A couple of small asks before you deliver the bundle:

1) Please put machine-only service accounts into a separate tab in the XLSX rather than excluding them; we need to see them but flagged.
2) For SAML assertions, redact PrincipalName and email but keep role and auth_time.
3) Can you supply the attestation as a short DocuSign template we can sign to confirm receipt and review (we prefer a one-click attestation for this phase)?

If you can deliver the first drop (ZIP + XLSX + SAML samples) to the S3 pre-signed link by Jan 4, we will attempt to finalize the SIG response by Jan 7. We may request a quick clarifying call after the files arrive.

Thanks for moving fast — Taylor
